title: Replication package: Does Output Protection Blunt Carbon Pricing? Evidence from Large Industrial Emitters under Canada's National Price Floor
description:
Code and data that reproduce every table, figure and number in the paper Does Output Protection Blunt Carbon Pricing? Evidence from Large Industrial Emitters under Canada's National Price Floor (Tang, Gong, Fu and Chen, 2026). The paper asks whether large emitters regulated under Alberta's output-based carbon-pricing systems (SGER, CCIR, TIER) responded differently from comparable large multi-province firms in other Canadian provinces once the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act made a rising national carbon-price floor binding in 2019, using firm-level emissions (Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program, 2004–2023), green patent stocks (Canadian Intellectual Property Office, CPC Y02/Y04S) and sector-level emission intensity (Statistics Canada real GDP).

Contents: the 23-step data-construction pipeline (pipeline/), the estimation scripts (analysis/: two-way fixed-effects difference-in-differences with time-varying and pre-policy fixed treatment definitions, event studies with joint lead tests, a facility-level within-firm check, firm-, province- and sector–province-cell clustering, wild cluster bootstraps, Conley–Taber placebo provinces, cell-level permutation tests, Honest DiD relative-magnitudes confidence sets, heterogeneity and oil-price-cycle analyses), a Makefile that regenerates all outputs, the analysis-ready firm–year and company–province–year panels, the small raw inputs, and full variable documentation (data/data_dictionary.md, data/analysis_ready/CODEBOOK.md). Bulk public sources that are too large to redistribute (CIPO patent researcher datasets, Statistics Canada bulk tables) are fetched by data/download.sh. Data licences and required attribution statements are listed in data/README.md.
